concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a young LION warrior with a full mane of fern fronds, the SECOND stage of a two-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6 (the round lion cub), in the same view and pose as image 1, standing in a low pouncing crouch on four short legs, body turned slightly to the viewer-right, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face; 2 fern mane; 3 body; 4 four legs; 5 tail with pine cone tip; 6 two fern whips with acorn-cap claws;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face: a lion cub head: tawny golden-brown fur, a pale cream muzzle and chin, two big leaf-green eyes (one catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, an open confident grin with one small fang where the old mouth is; the forehead gem piece becomes a small carved light-wood badge shaped like a leaf, the same size and place.
2 fern mane: a lion mane of dark-green fern fronds: each old leaf becomes a fern frond (a long leaf with small rounded leaflets along both edges) in the same place and pointing the same way, and the three gold chest plates become three short fern fronds hanging over the chest under the chin; no stripes, no yellow, no gold.
3 body: a small tawny golden-brown torso with a pale cream belly, same outline; no stripes.
4 four legs: four short sturdy tawny lion legs with the same outline; at the BOTTOM end each paw is covered by a brown scaly acorn cap like a little boot, where the old gold claw cuff was; no stripes.
5 tail with pine cone tip: a long thin tawny lion tail with the same curve, ending in a brown pine cone (overlapping scales, flat colour) where the old crystal was; no thorns, no crystal.
6 two fern whips with acorn-cap claws: two curling dark-green fern-stem whips with the same curves (small fern leaflets instead of thorns), each ending in a big brown scaly acorn cap like a claw club where the old crystal was; no crystals, no thorns.

ATTITUDE: a fierce little lion about to pounce: brows angled down, an open confident grin with a small fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: tawny golden-brown fur with a pale cream muzzle, dark-green fern fronds, a carved light-wood leaf-shaped badge on the forehead, brown scaly acorn caps over the paws, big leaf-green eyes, a brown pine cone at the tail tip. Few colours.

AVOID: a green body, yellow stripes or green-and-yellow stripes, crystals, gems or diamonds, cyan or turquoise, gold armour or gold frames, thorny vines, feathery wing-shaped ears, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
